title: Desenvolvedor (a) Full Stack
description:
Quem somos:

Prezensa, uma empresa de tecnologia com foco em pessoas e compromisso real com resultados.

Nascemos da fusão de três consultorias com mais de 10 anos de trajetória (ESX, DevLand e Squad Premium) para criar um novo modelo no setor: mais humano, mais presente, mais estratégico.

Fomos pioneiros ao lançar a primeira PeopleTech do Brasil, unindo excelência técnica com acompanhamento próximo, de ponta a ponta.

Aqui, cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito.

Nossa cultura é baseada em transparência, colaboração e inovação. Valorizamos a autonomia e o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos talentos.

Você se identifica com esse propósito? Então, o seu futuro é na Prezensa.


Requisito da vaga



Hard Skills:

  • C# e .NET Core;
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful com ASP.NET Core;
  • Aplicação de arquiteturas como Clean, em camadas e DDD;
  • Padrões de projeto GoF e distribuídos;
  • EF Core, SQL e bancos relacionais/NoSQL;
  • Criação e implantação de microsserviços com Docker;
  • Prática em TDD e testes unitários;
  • Controle de versão com Git e uso de Git Flow;
  • Experiência com IA e Produtos financeiros.



Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade;
  • Dinamismo;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e com cliente;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.



Diferenciais:

  • Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
  • Mensageria (RabbitMQ e Kafka);
  • Pipelines CI/CD e segurança (JWT, OAuth e OpenID);
  • Conhecimento em front-end com frameworks modernos.




O que nós oferecemos:

  • Descontos nas Universidades FIAP, FGV, EBAC, Impacta e Full Cycle;
  • Parceria com a Open English e Cellep para aprimoramento do inglês;
  • Oportunidade de realizar cursos e certificações;
  • Apoio para participação em eventos de TI;
  • Acesso a serviços de saúde e bem-estar através da nossa parceria com a Wellhub;
  • Acesso à Onhappy, plataforma exclusiva que oferece descontos em passagens aéreas e hospedagens.

title: JavaScript Fullstack
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Work with a high skilled team to leverage complex and high quality machine learning and statistical models;
  • Implement model to service integration via DAG creations and ETL processes;
  • Evaluate model performance under real data testing results and remodelate accordingly;
  • Build scalable models and DAGs to enable new workflows creations in a high-usage, high-demand environment;
  • Work with worldwide multidisciplinary distributed team, participate in technical discussions and definitions using English as main communication language;
  • Leverage accurate model architecture and documentation.


Essential Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related areas;
  • Desire to combine theory and abilities to solve problems pragmatically, applying Machine Learning techniques and integrating them into larger systems;
  • Desire to work with product managers and software engineers, translating requirements into design and models into end-to-end production code;
  • Knowledge in probability and statistical modeling;
  • Hands-on experience in statistical analysis and Machine Learning modeling using Python;
  • Hands-on experience on model evaluation, integration, data transformation and deployment, covering the complete end-to-end cycle;
  • Knowledge in SQL and relational databases;
  • Knowledge with DAG definition and implementation.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Python notebooks, pandas;
  • Experience with PySpark, Airflow;
  • Experience with cloud tools (AWS, Azure, GCP) and orchestration tools;
  • Knowledge about model life cycle, data drift and model drift;
  • Experience with data structures;
  • Experience with finops data treatment and cost saving analysis.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: .NET/C# - React (Fullstack)
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.


Essential Skills

  • Experience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Locations: 100% Remote (BRAZIL), COLOMBIA (Medellin, Cartagena)


ABOUT VTRAC

VTRAC Consulting Corporation ( is a well-established Recruitment firm with a strong track record of providing quality resources in the Technology, Engineering, and management fields. POSITIONS

We are looking for quality-driven and assertive senior technology staffing services business developers with excellent English communication skills to expand new business while managing the existing clients. You will be working in an environment where personal and professional growth matters, and your compensation is associated with aggressive and accelerated rewards (NO CAPS) by your own commitment.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build new business and strong partnerships with clients in the Technology industry.
  • Organize and coordinate resources in order to execute the successful delivery of the Recruiting/Staffing services.
  • Market selective resources to targeted prospective clients.
  • Communicate, retain, and support existing and placed resources.
  • Work with clients to ensure their standards, protocols, and expectations.
  • Develop staffing services and preferably having a strong network in Microsoft (service providers or users), Cloud Computing, Data, AI, Financial Services, FinTech, and Auto manufacturing organizations.


QUALIFICATION

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Sales and Business Development.
  • Minimum 2 years of agency experience selling to technology organizations from start-ups to mid-sized and major accounts.
  • Minimum 1 year of agency recruitment (worked as a recruiter) background.
  • Minimum 1 year of agency recruitment supporting U.S. or Europe accounts.
  • Technical knowledge and experience in the technical evaluation of clients' requirements and candidates' skills.
  • Experience in providing staffing services and preferably having a network in AI, Data Streaming, Cloud Computing, financial services, FinTech, and Auto manufacturing organizations.
  • Extensive networking skills or having an existing network within IT companies in the U.S. (A MUST) and LATAM.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Very strong teamwork, time management, and allocation.
  • Work experience with CRM or Applicant Tracking System, and MS Word.


We thank all candidates in advance. Only selected candidates for interviews will be contacted. For other exciting opportunities, please visit us at VTRAC is an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Software Engineer Full Stack Pleno
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.

A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
  • Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Garantir excelência na experiência do usuário e performance front-end;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas.


Competências:

  • Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js (NestJS), PostgreSQL..
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
  • Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
  • Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
  • Experiência com APIs REST;
  • Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
  • Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
  • Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Gympass;
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: URGENT - Senior IT Agency Recruiters (Remote, BRAZIL)
description:
VTRAC Consulting Corporation Intelligent Resources


Thank you for applying to VTRAC opportunities. Please e-mail your resume as an MS-WORD document in confidence, Subject: Senior IT Agency Recruiter (Brazil), Attention: .


Position: Senior IT Agency Recruiters (Remote, BRAZIL)

Working hours: Eastern Times (12 pm to 9 pm or 8:30 am to 5:30 pm)

Position Type: Permanent x 2 (Base Salary + Bonus + Paid Vacation)

Locations: 100% Remote (BRAZIL)


ABOUT VTRAC

VTRAC Consulting Corporation ( is a well-established Recruitment firm with a strong track record of providing quality resources in the Technology, Engineering, and management fields. VTRAC was founded in 1993 by senior technology and business professionals and supports clients in LATAM and North America.


POSITIONS

We are looking for quality-driven and assertive senior and intermediate technology recruiters with great English communication skills to work with a supportive team where personal and professional growth matters, and associated rewards and competitive compensation are accelerated only by your own desire and commitment. You will be primarily responsible for finding, deeply technically and functionally evaluating, and presenting candidates, and coordinating with clients.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify, engage, and explore candidates’ real motivation and interest, validate their skills and competencies, and present quality talents in a timely manner.
  • In-depth technical and functional evaluation and assessment of technology candidates.
  • Participate in full-cycle recruitment and staffing assignments for both contract and permanent placement opportunities, for clients in the Technology, Engineering, automotive, and Finance sectors.
  • Network, research databases, contact, source, collect, screen applications, select, examine, evaluate, and interview candidates.
  • Coordinate and notify candidates on requirements for the prospective position, job offers, contracts, terms, and conditions of employment.
  • Partner and collaborate with other recruiters through teamwork, imparting your knowledge, experience, skills, and advice on staffing policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the presentation of candidates to prospective clients.
  • Prepare reporting on activities and results.


QUALIFICATION

  • Min 4+ years of recruitment experience with a strong network, preferably in the Microsoft (service providers or users), Cloud Computing, Data, AI, Financial Services, FinTech, and Auto manufacturing organizations.
  • Min 2 years of experience in DIRECT HEADHUNTING of permanent and contract technology candidates.
  • Min 2 years of experience as an agency recruiter working directly with the hiring clients (NOT through RPO).
  • Min 2 years of sales or sales support experience
  • MUST HAVE minimum 2+ years working with U.S. or Canadian markets.
  • Must have in-depth technical evaluation experience and be able to fully assess the candidate’s skills.
  • VERY STRONG networking, relationship-building, and very active recruitment-related social media engagement activities, especially on LinkedIn.
  • Fluent English communication skills (verbal and written).
  • STRONG teamwork, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Working experience with MS Word, CRM, or ATS systems.


We thank all candidates in advance. Only selected candidates for interviews will be contacted. For other exciting opportunities, please visit us at VTRAC is an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Tech Recruiter Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Tech Recruiter Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento de tecnologia de ponta a ponta ;
  • Realizar hunting ativo e geração de pipeline qualificado;
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais de forma estruturada, garantindo aderência cultural e técnica;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com líderes e stakeholders, atuando de forma consultiva;
  • Alimentar e gerenciar informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter , garantindo a qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor melhorias nos processos de recrutamento.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Sólida experiência como Tech Recruiter em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter e ferramentas de sourcing (boolean search, AI tools, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em perfis técnicos (Desenvolvedores, QA, DevOps, Data, Machine Learning, etc.);
  • Experiência com métricas de recrutamento (taxa de conversão, tempo de fechamento);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa , em ambiente remoto e dinâmico.
  • Habilidades de negociação, comunicação e resiliência.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em GCP , com vivência prática em serviços como Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com Oracle Cloud (OCI).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades.   • Contratação: CLT

  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em GCP , com vivência prática em serviços como Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.

  • Experiência com Oracle Cloud (OCI).

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: 126713-Solution Engineer （DJI Enterprise-Brazil）
description:
DJI is the global leader in developing and manufacturing innovative drones and camera technology for commercial and recreational use.

DJI was founded and is led by people with a passion for remote-controlled helicopters and experts in flight-control technology and camera stabilization field. We are dedicated to making aerial technology accessible, reliable and easy to use for creators, innovators and businesses around the world.


Job Responsibilities

  • Conduct training for regional partners on drone products, ecosystem, and solutions
  • Conduct product feature test, solution POC (Proof of Concept)
  • Engage with customers and partners in technical discussions, accurately identify customer needs, and provide technical and solutions support
  • Develop and maintain key regional customer, gather industry insights, and collect product feedback
  • Analyze regional market demands and explore new drone applications across emerging industries and scenarios

Qualifications

  • Fluent in Portuguese and Chinese (both spoken and written), English will be a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a STEM field (Electrical Engineering, Communications, Computer Science, Surveying, Mechanical Engineering, etc.)
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in pre-sales or product management background
  • Strong presentation skills with experience in key account communication; collaborative mindset with strong initiative and self-motivation
  • Excellent documentation, communication, and technical comprehension skills
  • This role involves significant regional travel, estimated at up to 50% .

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE - DevOps
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) SRE Sênior para atuar em ambientes críticos e altamente escaláveis, garantindo confiabilidade, performance e segurança em soluções baseadas em AWS. Além das responsabilidades técnicas, você também será um parceiro estratégico do time de pré-venda , ajudando a entender as necessidades dos clientes e propondo as melhores soluções.


Se você tem experiência sólida em infraestrutura, automação e práticas DevOps, e gosta de atuar próximo ao negócio, essa oportunidade é para você!



Responsabilidades

  • Definir soluções de infraestrutura em cloud AWS e dar suporte em todo o ciclo de vida dos serviços (arquitetura, implantação e operação).
  • Apoiar o time de pré-venda, entendendo as necessidades dos clientes e sugerindo soluções adequadas.
  • Elevar a resiliência dos ambientes, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e monitoramento proativo.
  • Planejar e executar processos e soluções com base em dados e boas práticas.
  • Desenvolver componentes e APIs para suportar equipes e melhorar a gestão do time de SRE.
  • Participar da resolução de incidentes críticos e crises.
  • Construir processos e boas práticas para evoluir a visão de confiabilidade.
  • Garantir requisitos de segurança e compliance.
  • Gerenciar esteiras de CI/CD e promover integração entre ferramentas e provisionamento.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação superior em TI, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com IaC (Terraform, Atlantis).
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Processos de CI/CD (Jenkins, Groovy).
  • Infraestrutura e redes.
  • Orquestração de containers (ECS, Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Sistemas Linux.
  • AWS (Route53, ECS, SQS, STS, API Gateway, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFront, SSM, WAF, GuardDuty, Inspector, CloudWatch).
  • Sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Arquitetura de mensageria (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ).


Diferenciais

  • Certificações AWS (Associate ou Professional).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Oportunidade para: Desenvolvedor(a) .Net Sênior


Responsável pelo desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de sistemas corporativos utilizando tecnologias .NET, assegurando alta qualidade, segurança e performance. Atuará em projetos estratégicos, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento, interoperabilidade e integração entre sistemas.


Requisitos Essenciais

Experiência sólida em C# .NET Framework 4.5 e .NET Core.

Conhecimento em SQL Server e ORMs (Entity Framework).

Experiência com integrações REST/SOAP.

Vivência em metodologias ágeis.

Experiência com CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps).

Experiência em batch/processamento (Control-M).

Testes unitários e integrados.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e Manutenção

Desenvolver e manter aplicações em .NET Framework 4.5 e .NET Core (C#, ASP .net Core , MVC, Web API).

Implementar integrações com APIs REST, SOAP e serviços externos.

Garantir código limpo, seguro e aderente às boas práticas.

Atuar em processos batch e de processamento (Control-M, aplicações EXE).

Implementar interoperabilidade entre sistemas (C# + DLLs VB6).

Arquitetura e Design

Avaliar tecnologias e propor soluções escaláveis e resilientes.

Elaborar desenho de arquitetura desde o início dos projetos.

Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade do código (ex.: SonarQube).

Qualidade e Testes

Criar e manter testes unitários, integrados e automatizados.

Utilizar ferramentas de testes integrados.

Participar de code reviews e assegurar conformidade com padrões internos e regulatórios.

DevOps e Deploy

Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

Automatizar processos de build e deploy.

Monitorar aplicações em produção, analisando logs e métricas para prevenção de falhas.


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto e CLT / PJ


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Senior Property Manager
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for an experienced Senior Property Manager to oversee operations, lead a team of junior property managers, and ensure smooth day-to-day management of residential and/or commercial properties. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of U.S. property management, proven leadership skills, and the ability to balance tenant relations, administrative efficiency, and team management in a fast-paced environment.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead, mentor, and provide guidance to junior on-site property managers, ensuring best practices are followed across the team
  • Oversee tenant communications, lease renewals, and resolution of escalated tenant issues
  • Assist in managing leasing activities, including advertising, coordinating with your on-site team for property showings, applicant screening, and drafting lease agreements
  • Ensure compliance with lease terms, investigate violations, and address tenant disputes professionally
  • Supervise vendor coordination for maintenance repairs and upgrades, and coordinate with the on-site property manager for larger renovation projects
  • Collaborate with leadership on property marketing strategies and operational improvements
  • Oversee properties’ financial performance, including drafting budgets, tracking actuals to budget, and dictating strategies to maximize financial outcomes


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong background in U.S. residential and/or commercial property management (required)
  • Previous experience managing or leading a property management team
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software



Why You’ll Love Working Here:


Competitive Compensation

We offer a competitive monthly salary of USD 1,500 - 2,500, based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Data Scientist \"987402\"
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver, treinar e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio, utilizando linguagens como Python ou R.

Realizar modelagem de dados, estruturando e preparando bases de dados para análises avançadas e para consumo por modelos estatísticos e preditivos.

Extrair, manipular e analisar dados utilizando SQL, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance nas consultas.

Avaliar, validar e monitorar o desempenho dos modelos em produção, aplicando métricas estatísticas e ajustes contínuos para melhoria de resultados.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas, documentando processos, hipóteses e resultados de forma clara e acessível.


O que você precisa ter


  • Python ou R;
  • SQL;
  • Pytorch.

Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration


  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

title: Vendedor(a)
description:
Com foco em inovação e excelência em nossas operações, buscamos profissionais apaixonados e apaixonadas por vendas e atendimento aos clientes para se juntar à nossa equipe e desfrutar de um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, desafiador e gratificante, que proporciona grandes oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e financeiro.

Responsabilidades:

Televendas ativo de materiais elétricos, hidráulicos, itens para MRO, iluminação, automação elétrica industrial, EPI's, linha contra incêndio, entre outros, para clientes corporativos (PJ), como construtoras, incorporadoras, indústrias, engenharias, estabelecimentos comerciais, etc.

Prospecção de clientes, captação, reativação, acompanhamento e pós-venda.

Análise de mercado, da posição e das necessidades dos clientes, identificação de oportunidades de negócios;

Foco no atendimento aos clientes e na estratégia de resultados

Requisitos:

Experiência com venda ativa por telefone, prospecção e reativação de clientes, acompanhamento e pós-venda, negociação e técnicas de atendimento e vendas à clientes corporativos.

Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de persuasão e negociação estratégica;

Boa capacidade de organização, de atenção e proatividade;

Foco no cliente


Remuneração atrativa composta por salário fixo + comissionamento + premiação + VT + VR/VA + Assist. Médica + Assist. Odontológica + Seguro de Vida + Auxílio-Educação


Trabalho presencial (Porto Alegre), de segunda a sexta, horário comercial.

title: Científico de datos
description:
We’re Hiring | Data Scientist (Remote – Full Time)

Staffing Abroad is currently looking for a Data Scientist for one of our U.S.-based clients in the digital assets and FinTech space. In this role, you’ll transform complex datasets into predictive insights that drive strategy, growth, and performance across Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Operations.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and deploy machine learning and predictive models for revenue forecasting and business optimization
  • Perform statistical analysis, feature engineering, and A/B testing
  • Develop dashboards and insights using Domo for executive decision-making
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Finance, and Marketing teams
  • Explore and prototype AI/ML innovations, including LLMs and generative AI.


Tech Stack:

Snowflake must | Rivery | dbt | Domo or similar | Python expert level | SQL expert level


What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning
  • Strong skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred)
  • Background in FinTech, SaaS, or data-driven environments is a plus
  • Strong business mindset and data storytelling skills
  • Advanced English level (C1) required


Why apply?

  • 100% remote role
  • Competitive compensation with bonus eligibility
  • High-impact, data-driven projects
  • Collaborative and fast-paced work environment
  • Payment in USD


Interested or know someone who might be a great fit?

Feel free to apply or reach out directly.

title: Content Operations Manager
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support 1,000+ providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.



What You Will Do



Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings



Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.


WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.

  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Staff Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Angular)
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos buscando um Senior Full Stack Engineer Java para atuar diretamente no time de nosso cliente localizado na Nova Zelândia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de uma aplicação SaaS em um ambiente de equipe colaborativa e multifuncional.


Horário de Trabalho:

É necessário disponibilidade para comunicação com o time do cliente entre 18h e 22h (BRT) - Segunda a Quinta-feira BRT .


Requisito Obrigatório:

Inglês fluente para comunicação verbal e escrita com equipes internacionais.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolver e manter uma aplicação SaaS utilizando Java, Angular e MySQL
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais e Product Managers para implementar novas funcionalidades
  • Contribuir para decisões arquiteturais e design técnico
  • Participar de cerimônias Agile e fornecer estimativas precisas de desenvolvimento
  • Realizar revisão de código e garantir altos padrões de qualidade


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Java: Mínimo de 12 anos de experiência incluindo JUnit, Hibernate, Spring Frameworks e Gradle
  • Angular: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência utilizando Angular, Tailwind, Jest ou similares
  • Banco de Dados MySQL: Design e otimização de queries, profiling,
  • Serviços AWS: EC2, ECS, RDS, Lambda, etc
  • CI/CD e Testes Automatizados: Expêriencia com BuildKite, Jenkins ou similares


Habilidades Profissionais:

  • Inglês fluente para comunicação e eficaz com equipes técnicas e não técnicas, especialmente em ambientes remotos
  • Colaboração ativa em equipes multifuncionais internacionais
  • Documentação técnica clara e detalhada
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver desafios técnicos


Responsabilidades de Segurança:

  • Aderir à Política de Segurança de TI da empresa
  • Seguir as diretrizes do OWASP Top 10
  • Participar de treinamentos de segurança, conforme necessário


Outros Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade para comunicação dentro do horário mencionado
  • Compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento profissional
  • Alinhamento com os valores da empresa

ID:

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of mechanical & manufacturing
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.


WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Senior Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Developer (Palantir/PySpark) , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

● English fluently

Palantir Foundry, Typescript, React JS, Workshop, Pyspark

· • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications

Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.

  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications
  • Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
  • Improve application User Interface and visualization design
  • Implement operational applications using Foundry Tools (Workshop, Quiver, and Slate).
  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Develop writeback functionality into the tool as needed.
  • Implement data visualizations using Foundry Tools (Quiver and Contour) and/or Power BI.
  • Maintain applications as usage grows and requirements change.
  • Develop data pipelines using PySpark to create datasets, Foundry objects, and User Interface applications.
  • Collaborate with the Data Engineering Team to understand the ontology and data pipelines supporting the applications.
  • Support end-to-end data pipeline development using Python and PySpark for ETL processes.
  • Support designing and building high-scale data-intensive workflows.
  • Perform data validations and analysis, using PyTest to create and implement unit tests.
  • Implement Foundry Expectations within Foundry Health checks for automated validations.
  • Monitor and debug critical issues such as data staleness or data quality.
  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality.
  • Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified through testing
  • Palantir

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability


For more information, write to

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label SaaS architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
